title: Arrow comparison between a restricted global mate and an affine-chart mate
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be proper, flat and locally of finite presentation, and let $g:Y'\to Y$, with $Y,Y'$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-flat-morphism]. Let $X'=X\times_Y Y'$ [def-pc-fibre-product], and let $a,a'$ be right adjoints of the canonical lifted derived direct images [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-direct-image, lem-pc-qcqs-derived-direct-image-right-adjoint]. Assume the ordinary canonical derived base-change maps are invertible on every quasi-coherent complex [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. Fix $K\in D_{QCoh}(Y)$ and affine opens $V\subset Y$, $W\subset Y'$ with $W\subset g^{-1}(V)$. Put $U=f^{-1}(V)$ and $U'=f'^{-1}(W)$; assume the (automatic) compactness and quasi-separatedness of $U$. Let $f_V:U\to V$ be the restriction and $g_W:W\to V$ the induced map. Let $b,b'$ be any right adjoints to the canonical lifted direct images of $f_V$ and the projection $U\times_V W\to W$, with their adjunctions, and assume ordinary derived base change for this chart square on every quasi-coherent complex. Let $q:U'\to U\times_V W$ have composites with the two projections and the open inclusions $U\to X$, $W\to Y'$ equal to $U'\to X'\to X$ and $U'\to X'\to Y'$, respectively. Then, in the arrow category of $D(\mathcal O_{U'})$, there exists an isomorphism from the restriction to $U'$ of the ambient image of the global canonical mate at $K$ to the image under $Lq^*$ of the ambient image of the chart canonical mate at $LV^*K$ [def-sc-duality-equation-base-change-map, def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps, def-pc-derived-pullback]. No invertibility of either mate is assumed.

proof.text: Set gW=W→Y′→Y. Construct r from the two evident projections on f′ inverse(W). Flip the open restriction pullback square and paste horizontally with the original pullback square. Pullback hom_ext identifies r with this pasted square’s isoPullback.hom, so r is invertible. Its two projection identities follow by pullback.lift_fst and pullback.lift_snd.

The canonical lifted derived direct image X×_Y W→W has a right adjoint by [lem-pc-qcqs-derived-direct-image-right-adjoint]. Choose the canonical rightAdjoint and its adjunction; uniqueness determines its isomorphism class. Apply [lem-sc-proper-flat-right-adjoint-basechange-hbeta] to gW and f. Then [lem-sc-right-adjoint-mate-new-base-open] gives eW from the restricted global mate to the derived pullback along r of this intermediate mate.

The resLE equation identifies gW with W→V→Y. From the two supplied q projection equations obtain the r,q projection identities; cancel the mono W→Y′ for the second one. Apply [lem-sc-right-adjoint-mate-old-base-open] to obtain eV from the intermediate mate pulled back along r to the chart mate pulled back along q. Compose eW and eV as arrow isomorphisms and introduce Nonempty.

proof_origin.note: Lean decomposition into successive new-base and old-base one-open comparisons; geometric pullback construction and composition are proved.

theorem proper_flat_rightAdjoint_chart_mate_comparison
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X Y Y' : Scheme.{u}}
    [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y] [CompactSpace Y'] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y']
    (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (a : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (a' : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y' ⥤ schemeDerivedQCohCategory (pullback f g))
    (adjf : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty X).ι ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage f) (fun E ↦
        (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint X Y
          (QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f)
          (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f) _ _ _ _ f _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ a)
    (adjf' : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty Y').lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback f g)).ι ⋙
        schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g)) (fun E ↦
        (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint _ _ _
          (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated (pullback.snd f g)) _ _ _ _
          (pullback.snd f g) _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ a')
    (hβ : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X,
      IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g (pullback.fst f g)
        pullback.condition E.obj))
    (K : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y)
    (V : Y.Opens) (W : Y'.Opens) (hWV : W ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    [IsAffine V.toScheme] [IsAffine W.toScheme]
    [CompactSpace (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme] [QuasiSeparatedSpace (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme]
    (b : schemeDerivedQCohCategory V.toScheme ⥤
      schemeDerivedQCohCategory (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme)
    (b' : schemeDerivedQCohCategory W.toScheme ⥤
      schemeDerivedQCohCategory (pullback (f ∣_ V) (g.resLE V W hWV)))
    (adjb : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty V.toScheme).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme).ι ⋙
        schemeDerivedDirectImage (f ∣_ V))
      (fun E ↦ (schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint _ _ (f ∣_ V)).fst
        E.obj E.property) ⊣ b)
    (adjb' : (schemeDerivedQCohProperty W.toScheme).lift
      ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback (f ∣_ V) (g.resLE V W hWV))).ι ⋙
        schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd (f ∣_ V) (g.resLE V W hWV)))
      (fun E ↦ (@schemeDerivedDirectImage_qcqs_hasRightAdjoint _ _ _
        (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated
          (pullback.snd (f ∣_ V) (g.resLE V W hWV))) _ _ _ _
        (pullback.snd (f ∣_ V) (g.resLE V W hWV)) _ _).fst E.obj E.property) ⊣ b')
    (hβV : ∀ E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme,
      IsIso (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap (f ∣_ V)
        (pullback.snd (f ∣_ V) (g.resLE V W hWV)) (g.resLE V W hWV)
        (pullback.fst (f ∣_ V) (g.resLE V W hWV)) pullback.condition E.obj))
    (q : ((pullback.snd f g) ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme ⟶
      pullback (f ∣_ V) (g.resLE V W hWV))
    (hq₁ : q ≫ pullback.fst (f ∣_ V) (g.resLE V W hWV) ≫ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι =
      ((pullback.snd f g) ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι ≫ pullback.fst f g)
    (hq₂ : q ≫ pullback.snd (f ∣_ V) (g.resLE V W hWV) ≫ W.ι =
      ((pullback.snd f g) ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι ≫ pullback.snd f g) :
    Nonempty (Arrow.mk
      ((schemeOpenRestriction (pullback f g) ((pullback.snd f g) ⁻¹ᵁ W)).mapDerivedCategory.map
        ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback f g)).ι.map
          (@dualityEquationBaseChangeMap _ X Y Y'
            (QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace f)
            (quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated f) _ _ _ _
            f g a a' adjf adjf' hβ K))) ≅
      Arrow.mk ((derivedPullback q).map
        ((schemeDerivedQCohProperty (pullback (f ∣_ V) (g.resLE V W hWV))).ι.map
          (dualityEquationBaseChangeMap (f ∣_ V) (g.resLE V W hWV) b b' adjb adjb' hβV
            ⟨(derivedPullback V.ι).obj K.obj,
              (derivedPullback_tensor_preserve_QCoh V.ι).1 K.obj K.property⟩))))
